subject: Post-call recap: WinScope MVP success plan, evaluation playbook & kickoff
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@winscope.ai>, Alex Gray <alex.gray@winscope.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: WinScope MVP success plan, evaluation playbook & kickoff

Thanks for the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned before the kickoff: 

Summary of needs (from discovery)
- MVP objective: reduce semantic-search latency on product catalog queries and raise retrieval relevance for long-tail SKUs.
- Primary success metric: 90th percentile generation latency <= 120ms for 256-token end-to-end calls, and +12% MAP on the evaluation set vs current baseline.
- Data constraints: customer catalog + product descriptions (~12M records). Sensitive PII is minimal; logs should be retained for 30 days.

Proposed evaluation plan (high-level)
1) Kickoff: environment setup + dataset transfer window (week 0).
2) Week 1: integration & smoke tests (embedding/ingest verification).
3) Weeks 2–3: controlled eval runs (batch queries + A/B stability).
4) Week 4: final readout, decision meeting.

Owners (initial)
- Redwood: Mateo (eng lead / AM), Marissa (solutions / eval plan), Ben (platform ops).
- WinScope: Samira (product), Alex (platform).

Immediate asks / next steps
- Samira: confirm a 2-hour kickoff window next week and attach a sample of the product description CSV (1000 rows).
- Alex: provide required firewall IPs and an account owner for SSO (if using Private deployment).
- Marissa: I'll loop in a short evaluation playbook and the mutual action plan doc by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: placeholder for the evaluation scope workbook (winscope-eval-scope.xlsx) and MAP (mutual-action-plan.docx).

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation playbook + owners (follow-up to Mateo's recap)

Hi all — circling with the playbook and owners at a bit more granularity. Attached: winscope-eval-scope.xlsx (tabbed with timelines and test harness).

Quick outline: 
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): Drop sample and share SSO details. (Owners: WinScope / Alex)
- Week 1 (integration): Redwood will provision a hosted sandbox, run ingestion pipeline, and validate KV cache behavior. (Owners: Ben + Redwood infra; WinScope: Alex)
- Week 2 (controlled eval): Run the baseline and Redwood variants; collect latencies and MAP. (Owners: Marissa leads eval; Mateo PM)
- Week 3 (user study + qualitative): UX researcher to run quick 10-user review on long-tail copy. (Owners: WinScope UX + Redwood product)
- Week 4 (final readout): Joint scoring and decisions; deliverable: readout doc + action items.

Acceptance criteria (proposed) — candidate gate for success: 
- Quantitative: 90th pctl latency <= 120ms AND MAP improvement >= 12%.
- Qualitative: >= 70% preference in UX blind test for long-tail descriptions.

Logistics / operational asks: 
- Ben: we'll need a temporary service account and two CIDR ranges (we'll open a ticket once Alex confirms network owner).
- Samira: please confirm whether data reviewers need NDA addendum (we can offer a short addendum if required).

Attachments: winscope-eval-scope.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx (mutual-action plan includes milestone ownership and delivery dates).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
